pattern.title: Answer evidence-obligation release ledger
pattern.value: Prevent an answer plan from silently omitting a required source, caveat or known counterevidence before it reaches a user.
pattern.success_metric: Unsupported-claim escapes and answer-completeness review time.

decision.instructions: How complete is `answer_plan` against the explicit obligations in `evidence_ledger`? Assess named claim/source/counterevidence obligations only; do not generate the answer. First select insufficient if the plan or ledger is absent, ambiguous, or cannot be matched. Otherwise, if direct listed counterevidence is omitted or misrepresented, select counterevidence_unaddressed even when claim, source, or limitation obligations are also missing; partial applies only when counterevidence is addressed or none is listed.

criteria.complete: Every required claim has its required evidence or stated limitation, and listed counterevidence is addressed.
criteria.partial: At least one required claim/source/limitation obligation is missing.
criteria.counterevidence_unaddressed: A listed direct counterevidence item is omitted or treated as supporting the claim.
criteria.insufficient: The plan or ledger is absent, ambiguous, or cannot be matched.

pattern.follow_up: Code enforces exact obligation IDs and raw source bindings. A semantic `complete` result is only a review signal; missing deterministic IDs fails closed.
pattern.code_owns: Build obligation ledger, validate IDs/revisions, count coverage, format answer and send it.
pattern.baseline: Check each selected citation in isolation after drafting.
pattern.comparison_to_iteration_1: Unlike L01's retention of counterevidence and L11's coverage score, this composes named obligations into a release gate.
pattern.origin: Task-authored iteration 2 application of documented typed-decision components. It is not a claim of global novelty.
pattern.limits: No semantic ledger check proves an answer is factually correct.

policy.threshold_status: Provisional screening settings, not calibrated deployment thresholds.

pattern.design_status: Experimental composition with bounded prior-art comparison; not production-qualified.

state.answer_plan: claim price: $10 citing price_source; claim reliability: 99.9% citing reliability_source; limitation: one-month measurement; counterevidence: none.
state.evidence_ledger: Required: price->price_source; reliability->reliability_source; state measurement-window limitation. Counterevidence: none.

state.answer_plan: claim price: $10 citing price_source; claim reliability: 99.9%.
state.evidence_ledger: Required: price->price_source; reliability->reliability_source; state measurement-window limitation. Counterevidence: none.

state.answer_plan: claim all users can receive refunds citing policy.
state.evidence_ledger: Required: refund claim->policy. Counterevidence: clearance items are excluded from refunds and must be named.

state.answer_plan: Claim: all products have a two-year warranty. No source is cited.
state.evidence_ledger: Required: cite warranty policy and state exclusions. Direct counterevidence: refurbished products have a six-month warranty.

cases.case_purpose: Missing source and omitted counterevidence coexist

state.answer_plan: The plan refers to Product A.
state.evidence_ledger: The ledger refers only to Product B; no relationship or matching claim is supplied.

state.answer_plan: Claim warranty: two years, except refurbished goods have six months. No source cited.
state.evidence_ledger: Required: cite warranty policy. Direct counterevidence: refurbished goods have six months and this must be stated.

cases.case_purpose: Counterevidence addressed but ordinary source obligation missing

scope: Preserved original expectations; new cases frozen before inference. Development synthetic screen only.
